import tempfile, io

class Buf:
    def __init__(self):
        self._f = tempfile.TemporaryFile()
    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return getattr(self._f, name)
    def write(self, b):
        return self._f.write(b)
    def flush(self):
        self._f.flush()

b = Buf()
tw = io.TextIOWrapper(b, encoding='utf-8', write_through=False)
tw.write('hello\n')
tw.flush()
print('fileno', b.fileno())
b._f.seek(0)
print(b._f.read())
import subprocess, sys
subprocess.run(['echo','foo'], stdout=tw)
tw.flush()
b._f.seek(0)
print(b._f.read())
"
